about: Refusal-first corpus for the seal verifier and the audit-log verifier. `valid` means: for set `seal` the bundle is internally consistent (ok); `seal-authentic` it is authentic under the pinned key or key file (authentic); `seal-content` its content was checked against the supplied text (content_checked); `audit` the log verifies (ok); `audit-authentic` every line is signed and verifies under the pinned key (authentic). `codes`, where present, are the names of failed checks and are compared as a subset. Generated by tools/build_conformance_corpus.py: regenerated, never hand-edited.

test_keys.note: published test vectors, not secrets: seeds are bytes(range(32)) and bytes(range(32,64))
